properties.description: Meets at the Landsports tree next to the basketball court.

properties.name: Star
properties.description: Previously Northstar, Star is a quieter activity hour

properties.name: Cards and Games
properties.description: Play your favorite card and board games. Magic, euchre, table hockey and more!

properties.name: Drama
properties.description: Put on a play, walk in a fashion show, or come up with a new theme song for AGQ.

properties.name: Swimming
properties.description: Meet at the buddy board to put your tag up, then enjoy a nice splash in Burt Lake.

properties.name: Sailing
properties.description: Sign up for sailing lessons and venture accross Burt Lake. Go accross and back to recieve the Admirals Award.

properties.name: Canoeing
properties.description: Grab a paddle and get ready to row. Explore the shore of AGQ, listen to music on the water, or have a pirate battle!

properties.name: Woodshop
properties.description: Try cutting out your initial or making something to gift to your parents. Practice cutting, nailing, and painting here!

properties.name: Arts and Crafts
properties.description: Let your creative side loose here at A+C.

properties.name: Library
properties.description: Get lost in a book or take a quiet break from the action.

properties.name: Wall
properties.description: Your cabin will get the chance to climb the wall. If you make it up, you can cruise down on the zip-line!

properties.name: Barn
properties.description: Sign up for trail rides and learn to ride one of AGQ's sweetest four-legged friends.

properties.name: Water Skiing
properties.description: Sign up for water skiing and zip around Burt Lake. Practice getting up on both skiis, or maybe even one!

properties.name: Funk
properties.description: Fun-Understanding-of-Nature-Knowledge is a great way to explore AGQ and learn more about the ecosystem around you!
